evals.name: folder-to-webfont
evals.prompt: I have a folder of SVG icons at /var/www/convert-font/skills/svg-to-icon-font/evals/inputs/iconset (a mix of filled and outline/stroke styles). Turn the whole folder into an icon webfont I can use on my website, and explain how to drop it into a project. Save the generated font into the outputs directory you were given.
assertions: Outline/stroke icon is non-empty (strokes were outlined to fills)

evals.name: single-svg-react-usage
evals.prompt: Here's a single icon: /var/www/convert-font/skills/svg-to-icon-font/evals/inputs/star.svg. Make it into an icon font called AppIcons and show me the exact HTML/CSS to render the star at 32px in red in my React app. Save the font into the outputs directory you were given.
assertions: Font has exactly 1 real glyph (the star)
answer.md shows React usage at 32px in red
answer.md references the actual generated class name

evals.name: add-to-existing-font
evals.prompt: Add the icon /var/www/convert-font/skills/svg-to-icon-font/evals/inputs/existing/bell.svg to my EXISTING icon font, which is the MyFont.woff already in your outputs directory (with its MyFont.css). Don't create a new font — extend that one in place, then tell me the new icon's class name.
assertions: Existing mi- prefix preserved (NOT switched to rvi-)
bell glyph carries real (outlined) path data
